description: 白象精准插入第八横线赢后
explanation_en: A precise bishop interposition on the eighth rank disconnects Black's rook and bishop and wins the queen.

intro.popup: 💡 拦截：黑Rd8、黑Bf8同在第八横线，黑后在c7。白象插e8——切断第八横线后，黑后如何逃？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Interference: Black's rook is on d8, bishop on f8, and queen on c7. White can interpose the bishop on e8 to cut the eighth rank. How can Black save the queen?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Be8！象插e8切断Rd8与Bf8，黑后被迫到f7，Bxf7赢后！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Be8! The bishop cuts the connection between Rd8 and Bf8. The queen is forced to f7, where Bxf7 wins it.

moves.popup: 白象Bf7+！先将军把黑王赶到角落h8。
moves.popup_en: Bf7+! The check first drives the black king into the corner on h8.

moves.popup: 黑王Kh8——角落中，第八横线两端：Rd8在d8，Bf8在f8。
moves.popup_en: The king moves to h8. Black's rook on d8 and bishop on f8 still coordinate along the eighth rank.

moves.popup: 白象Be8！插入e8，精确切断Rd8与Bf8的第八横线联系——Qc7被迫应对e8的威胁！
moves.popup_en: Be8! The bishop precisely cuts the eighth-rank connection between Rd8 and Bf8, forcing the queen on c7 to answer the threat to e8.

moves.popup: 黑后Qf7——唯一应对，但掉入陷阱！
moves.popup_en: Qf7 is the only defense, but it falls into the trap.

moves.popup: 白象Bxf7！赢得黑后——拦截战术完美执行！
moves.popup_en: Bxf7! White wins the black queen. The interference tactic is perfectly executed.
